Shift Report for 2026-08-05, 08:58 to 15:35:

The period was marked by two instances of a blue Ford F-150 pickup truck arriving at and departing from the main gate, with corresponding activity at the loading dock. 

At 08:58, the blue Ford F-150 arrived at the main gate. Two minutes later, at 09:00, it was observed at the loading dock with the driver unloading. The vehicle then departed through the main gate at 09:02.

The vehicle returned at 15:31, arriving at the main gate, and proceeded to the loading dock where the driver was again observed unloading at 15:33. The blue Ford F-150 then departed through the main gate at 15:35, marking the end of the observed activity for the shift.

No other unusual or notable activity was reported during the shift.
